steps.title: Fetch that repository's README
steps.summary:
get_file_contents  modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk  path=README.md

Title: MCP Python SDK
Subtitle: Python implementation of the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Docs: https://py.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/

What is MCP? (from the README)
  The Model Context Protocol lets you build servers that expose data
  and functionality to LLM applications in a secure, standardized way.
  With this SDK you can:
    • Build MCP servers that expose tools, resources, and prompts
    • Build MCP clients that connect to any MCP server
    • Speak stdio, Streamable HTTP, and SSE

Requirements: Python 3.11+
Install:      uv add "mcp[cli]"   (or pip install "mcp[cli]")

The README includes a 15-line FastMCP-style server (MCPServer + @mcp.tool
add(a,b) and a greeting resource) and a 10-line Client example.
License: MIT
